description: 卡塔兰开局——兵的占领与子的控制完美融合，18步练习注释

intro.popup: 大象斜线加 c4——兵的占领与子的控制完美结合！卡塔兰是 A1 占领中心与 A2 控制中心知识的综合应用，观察 Bg2 如何与 d4+c4 协同工作
intro.popup_en: The Catalan combines pawn occupation with piece control: watch how the bishop on g2 coordinates with the d4- and c4-pawns to influence the center.

outro.popup: 占领与控制相辅相成，是最强大的中心策略。d4 占领 + c4 侧翼控制 + Bg2 远程覆盖——三重叠加让对手的任何反制都变得极为困难。
outro.popup_en: Pawn occupation and piece control work together. The d4-pawn occupies the center, c4 influences d5, and Bg2 adds long-range pressure. This layered control makes counterplay difficult.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 1.d4 — A1技能：兵占中心！
d4 兵直接占领中心格，控制 c5 和 e5。这是我们在 A1「占领中心」学过的基本技能。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 1.d4 - A1 skill: occupy the center with a pawn!
The d-pawn takes a central square and controls c5 and e5, applying the principle from A1.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 1...Nf6 — 黑马控制 e4 和 d5！
黑马出动，控制 e4 和 d5，直接挑战白方中心计划。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 1...Nf6 - Black's knight controls e4 and d5!
The developing knight immediately contests White's central plan.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 2.c4 — A2技能：侧翼兵控制 d5！
c4 不在中心，却控制 d5（超现代思想）。现在 d5 受 d4 和 c4 双重控制！这是 A2「控制中心」的典型应用。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 2.c4 - A2 skill: a flank pawn controls d5!
Although c4 is not a central square, the pawn influences d5. That square is now controlled by both c4 and d4, a classic example of indirect central control.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 2...e6 — 黑方稳固，建立基础。
e6 支撑 d5，为 d5 的推进做准备，同时开放黑格象的道路。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 2...e6 - Black builds a solid base.
The pawn supports a later ...d5 and opens a diagonal for the dark-squared bishop.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 3.g3 — 卡塔兰的特征！准备 Bg2！
g3 是卡塔兰开局的标志性步骤，为象发展到 g2 铺路，将开启覆盖 d5 的长斜线控制。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 3.g3 - A signature Catalan move!
White prepares to fianchetto the bishop on g2, where it will influence d5 along the long diagonal.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 3...d5 — 黑方占领 d5，建立中心！
黑方推 d5，形成 d5+e6 稳固的中心结构，直接挑战白方的 c4 控制。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 3...d5 - Black occupies d5 and builds a center!
The pawns on d5 and e6 form a solid structure and challenge White's influence from c4.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 4.Bg2 — A2核心！象入长斜线！
白象进入 g2，沿 h1-a8 对角线延伸——这条斜线直接覆盖 d5！
现在 d5 格受到：d4（占领）+ c4（侧控）+ Bg2（斜线）三重控制！
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 4.Bg2 - The A2 idea: the bishop joins the long diagonal!
The bishop on g2 directly influences d5.
Now d5 is controlled by the d4-pawn, influenced by c4, and covered by Bg2: three layers of control!

moves.popup:
⬇️ 4...Be7 — 黑方出象，准备易位。
黑方标准发展，准备易位。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 4...Be7 - Develop and prepare to castle.
Black follows a standard development plan.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 5.Nf3 — 马加入中心控制网！
Nf3 控制 e5 和 d4，与 Bg2+c4+d4 共同形成完整的控制体系。发展完成，准备易位。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 5.Nf3 - The knight joins the central control network!
Nf3 influences e5 and d4, coordinating with Bg2, c4, and d4. White is ready to castle.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 5...O-O — 黑方易位完成。
黑方易位，王的安全得到保障。

⬆️ 6.O-O — 白方易位，阵型完整！
白方易位，Bg2 的长斜线控制完全激活。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 6.O-O - White castles and completes the setup!
With the king safe, the bishop on g2's long-diagonal influence is fully active.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 6...dxc4 — 黑方吃掉 c4！
黑方用 d5 兵吃掉 c4 兵，中心发生变化！c4 控制 d5 的使命已经完成（通过兑换打开局面），但 Bg2 的斜线现在更加开放了！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 6...dxc4 - Black captures the c4-pawn!
The center changes as the d5-pawn takes c4. The c-pawn has fulfilled its role of influencing d5; the exchange also opens the Catalan bishop's diagonal.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 7.Qc2 — 后出动，准备夺回 c4！
白后到 c2，同时为夺回 c4 兵做准备，保持 c4 方向的控制。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 7.Qc2 - Develop the queen and prepare to recover c4!
The queen supports a recapture and keeps influence on the c-file.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 7...a6 — 黑方稳固翼路。
a6 防止白方象跳 Nb5 等，稳固后翼阵型。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 7...a6 - Black reinforces the queenside.
The pawn discourages Nb5 and helps secure Black's queenside setup.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 8.Qxc4 — 后夺回 c4 兵！
白后夺回 c4，重新控制 d5 方向。现在 Qc4+Bg2 双重控制 d5 区域。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 8.Qxc4 - The queen recaptures the pawn!
White restores control toward d5. Qc4 and Bg2 now combine to influence the d5 area.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 8...b5 — 黑方驱逐白后！
b5 攻击白后，迫使其后退。
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 8...b5 - Black attacks the queen!
The pawn gains space and forces the queen to move.

moves.popup:
⬆️ 9.Qc2 — 白后退守！
白后退到 c2，避免被攻击，但仍在 c 线上保持影响力。
moves.popup_en:
⬆️ 9.Qc2 - The queen retreats to safety!
It avoids the pawn attack while retaining influence along the c-file.

moves.popup:
⬇️ 9...Bb7 — 黑象进入长斜线！
黑象 Bb7 也占据长对角线，与 Bg2 正面对峙！
★ 总结：Bg2 vs Bb7 的斜线对抗是卡塔兰的核心——白方占领d4，侧控c4， 斜线Bg2，这是占领与控制最完美的结合！
moves.popup_en:
⬇️ 9...Bb7 - Black's bishop enters the long diagonal!
The bishop on b7 now faces White's bishop on g2.
★ Summary: the Bg2-Bb7 diagonal contest is central to the Catalan. White combines d4 occupation, c4 influence, and the long diagonal: a powerful blend of occupation and control.
